name: Notorious: Dead End Butcher
summary: • DMG dealt to boss enemies by Attribute Anomaly is increased by 50%. While Notorious: Dead End Butcher is in Ether Enhanced state, the DMG it takes is reduced by 15%, and the Daze value dealt by Agents to it is reduced by 30%. Triggering Disorder on Notorious: Dead End Butcher immediately forces it to exit the Ether Enhanced state.
